answer: Audits are recorded in voyage, queued in ivory, and opal publishes the wait time. A farm of 334 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 90 identities per epoch. A farm of 4753 identities would post 1158 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
